_about: Art method r3 pilot P4 (FFX-2 only, chapter 6 Leblanc): the hurt bake's joint rotations, in idle.png pixel coordinates (before padding). Positive angles turn clockwise on screen: she faces left, the hit comes from the party on the left, so she recoils back to the right. METHOD-CHECK step 3: upper body back 10 to 14 degrees about the hips, head back 8 to 12, fan arm down 20 to 30.
